articles.title: Army sets sights on indigenous suicide drones that can hit deep into enemy territory
articles.summary: The Indian Army is seeking advanced indigenous loitering munitions to enhance precision strike capabilities deep within enemy territory. These "suicide drones" are crucial for modern warfare, designed to counter heavy jamming and provide a tactical advantage. This procurement drive emphasizes self-reliance and technological superiority in defence, essential for future battlefield dominance.

articles.title: 2026 SAG Awards, Now Actor Awards, Nominations List in Full
articles.summary: The 2026 SAG Awards, rebranded as the Actor Awards, recently unveiled their nominations. The film 'One Battle After Another' leads with seven nods, including for best stunt ensemble. This announcement highlights significant achievements in the entertainment industry, providing insight into prominent cinematic works and individual performances that garner international attention.

articles.title: Reflagged by Russia, seized by US: Why so much interest in a rusty tanker in the Atlantic?
articles.summary: US forces seized a rusty crude oil tanker in the Atlantic after days of surveillance, drawing global attention. The vessel, floating north, became a focal point amidst rising tensions, with hints of Russian military involvement. This incident underscores critical aspects of international maritime security, naval operations, and geopolitical complexities in global oil trade.

articles.title: Israeli courts in limbo after abrupt death of judge leaves submarine corruption verdict pending
articles.summary: A judge is set to deliver a verdict concerning a suspect embroiled in the 'submarine and naval vessels affair'. This case involves two major defence procurement deals with a German conglomerate for acquiring submarines and other naval assets. The outcome will be significant, addressing alleged irregularities in national defence acquisitions, crucial for maintaining integrity within the armed forces' procurement processes.

articles.title: Transforming legal workflows with conversational AI agents
articles.summary: The legal profession is increasingly digital, moving beyond isolated traditional practices. This transformation brings significant challenges, including rapidly climbing caseloads and the continuous introduction of new rules. It highlights how technology is reshaping legal work, demanding professionals adapt to a dynamic, digitized environment and constantly evolving regulatory landscape. This reflects broader shifts across industries.

articles.title: Punjab launches second phase of 'Yudh Nashian Virudh' campaign to step up fight against drugs
articles.summary: Punjab has launched the second phase of its 'Yudh Nashian Virudh' campaign, significantly stepping up efforts to combat the pervasive drug menace across the state. This intensified initiative aims to strengthen the fight against drug abuse and trafficking, reflecting the state's commitment to fostering a healthier, drug-free society. Aspiring officers should understand the importance of such robust state-level governance in national security.

articles.title: MLB trade rumors: Ketel Marte trade buzz grows as New York Yankees, Chicago Cubs, and Los Angeles Dodgers watch Arizona Diamondbacks
articles.summary: MLB trade rumors are intensifying around Arizona Diamondbacks' player Ketel Marte, with several major teams reportedly expressing interest. The New York Yankees, Chicago Cubs, and Los Angeles Dodgers are among the clubs closely watching Marte, signaling potential significant movements in the Major League Baseball trade market. This growing buzz indicates a busy period for player transfers in professional baseball.
